Name: Anna Lollipop - Custom NPC UPDATE 3.1.0
Author: AnnasCreator
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/37593/37593-1793419425-1396675130.png[/img]

[/center]
[center][left][b][size=5]There's a foreign girl in town![/size][/b][/left]
[left]Anna showed up in Pelican Town out of the blue. She had nothing but hope that she’d find somewhere better. She came from the Gallia Continents, a place far, far away with its own language, its own culture, and corruption that eventually pushed her to leave. She spent all she had on a plane ticket and bus fare just to get here. Shortly after, she managed to befriend Haley and stay with her. Until her own place is fully built, that’s where you’ll find her. Around town, she’s the one being dramatic, complaining constantly about the summer heat, and standing outside in the snow during winter having the time of her life. She’s warm, chaotic and lollipop-obsessed, but still having a hard time adjusting to her new way of life.[/left]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/B61cDNQ2/Anna-Features.png[/img]

[left][b][size=4]Anna is still under development, but at this stage she’s mostly complete. Anna’s key features are:[/size][/b][/left]

[left][list]
[*]A full 5 event story arc through her heart events[/*]
[*]Full marriage content, with her own spouse room, patio and portrait furniture[/*]
[*]Marriage dialogue that changes with the season, the weather, and your relationship[/*]
[*]Her own custom home in town starting year 2[/*]
[*]A lollipop workshop in her house, with a broken lollipop press for you to repair[/*]
[*]23 lollipop flavors to make, each with its own art [/*]
[*]Visits the Ginger Island resort in her own beach outfit[/*]
[*]Takes part in every festival, from the Flower Dance to the Winter Star gift exchange[/*]
[*]Her own taste in films and snacks at the movie theater[/*]
[*]Reacts to the valley changing, from the Community Center to Willy’s boat[/*]
[*]Gallian spread throughout her dialogue (French)[/*]
[*]A warm winter outfit[/*]
[*]3 optional alternative styles[/*]
[*]and so much more![/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][/left]

[/b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/37593/37593-1794433720-1241921413.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/37593/37593-1794433493-712260439.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/37593/37593-1794433815-1070300943.png[/img][/center]
[b][size=4]UPDATE 3.1.0[/size][/b]
Anna has a lollipop workshop! There's a new door beside her bed. It stays locked at first, but reach 6 hearts with her in year 2 or later and she'll send you a letter. Once you've read it, the workshop is open, and your first visit plays a new scene with Anna. Anna's parents sent her a lollipop press from their shop in Gallia, and it arrived broken. Interact with the press to open Anna's repair bundle, which works like the Community Center bundles. It needs 5 Copper Bars, 3 Iron Bars, 3 Refined Quartz, 1 Fire Quartz, 1 Battery Pack and 10 Hardwood. Completing it restores the press. Make your own lollipops! Put in Sugar, Maple Syrup and any fruit (more to come), then press Start. Each batch makes 3 lollipops and takes 3 hours. While it works you get status lights, turning gears, steam and a bubbling sound, and a lollipop shows up above it when a batch is ready. Interact to collect. There are 23 flavors, each with its own art - Ancient Fruit, Apple, Apricot, Blueberry, Cactus Fruit, Cherry, Coconut, Cranberry, Crystal Fruit, Grape, Mango, Melon, Orange, Peach, Pineapple, Pomegranate, Powdermelon, Qi Fruit, Salmonberry, Spice Berry, Starfruit, Strawberry and Wild Plum. Any other fruit, including fruit from other mods, makes a classic Lollipop named after the fruit.
[b][size=4]Everything else in 3.1.0:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Each lollipop gives about half the energy of its fruit, so a batch of three gives you more than the fruit would[/*]
[*]Everyone in town likes lollipops, except Haley, who dislikes them[/*]
[*]Anna's movie theater reactions and concession stand snack preferences now actually work. They weren't loading before. She loves sweets, candy and cold treats, likes gourmet snacks, and dislikes Joja, healthy and sour ones[/*]
[*]Press settings (batch size, timing, sounds) are in AnnaLollipopMachine/config.json after the first launch[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]NOTE 1[/size][/b]: MAY BREAK ANNA FROM SAVES WITH PREVIOUS VERSION. IF THERE ARE ANY ISSUES IMMEDIATELY AFTER INSTALL SKIP A DAY BEFORE REPORTING. 
[b][size=4]NOTE 2[/size][/b]: THE DOWNLOAD IS NOW ONE FOLDER CONTAINING TWO MODS, "ANNA LOLLIPOP" AND "ANNA LOLLIPOP MACHINE". SMAPI LISTS BOTH. DELETE YOUR OLD ANNA LOLLIPOP FOLDER BEFORE INSTALLING.
